en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not Pray behind the one who wants the payment upon the Azaan and the Prayer, and do not accept his testimony’.
en.sarwar: 11. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith, the following is narrated: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Performing Salat (prayer) behind one who asks payment for saying Adhan (call for Salat (prayer)) and Salat (prayer) and his testimony are not admissible.’”
